decisions.reason: As the flagship shown on the home page and central to the announced enterprise messaging direction, the heavy public commitment and investment favor continuing it, even though it went unobserved in 2020 to 2021.
Its dedicated page and fit with the electronic document workflow strategy support persistence, though missing visibility since 2020 adds some risk of withdrawal.
Email and fax conversion extends the core multichannel business at low cost, but its low visibility and the long-term decline of fax make quiet withdrawal somewhat plausible.
The feature is cheap to maintain within the established fax service, yet its low visibility and fax's decline make it the easiest candidate to fold into the base offer.
Multi-engine scanning underpins the firm's secure, compliant email positioning, so dropping it would undermine the security direction despite the earlier sandbox withdrawal.
